en: Hi guys, I'm Lisa from Japanese Amo.
zh: 大家好，我是來自 Japanese Amo 的 Lisa。
ja: みなさん、こんにちは。Japanese Amo のリサです。
local: Hi guys, I'm Lisa from Japanese Amo.
ja_pron: Minasan, konnichiwa. Japanese Amo no Risa desu.
native: Hi guys, I'm Lisa from Japanese Amo.

en: This video is the first lesson for absolute beginners.
zh: 這支影片是給完全初學者的第一課。
ja: このビデオは全くの初心者向けの最初のレッスンです。
local: This video is the first lesson for absolute beginners.
ja_pron: Kono bideo wa mattaku no shoshinsha muke no saisho no ressun desu.
native: This video is the first lesson for absolute beginners.

en: So you haven't learned here, I got my head.
zh: 所以你還沒學過這裡，我已經準備好了。
ja: ここではまだ学んでいませんが、私は準備ができています。
local: So you haven't learned here, I got my head.
ja_pron: Koko de wa mada manande imasen ga, watashi wa junbi ga dekite imasu.
native: So you haven't learned here, I got my head.

en: Just check my kid, I got my guide.
zh: 只要查看我的教材，我有我的指南。
ja: 私の教材をチェックしてください。ガイドがあります。
local: Just check my kid, I got my guide.
ja_pron: Watashi no kyouzai o chekku shite kudasai. Gaido ga arimasu.
native: Just check my kid, I got my guide.

en: It's totally free.
zh: 這完全是免費的。
ja: これは完全に無料です。
local: It's totally free.
ja_pron: Kore wa kanzen ni muryou desu.
native: It's totally free.

en: And I hope you enjoy it.
zh: 希望你會喜歡。
ja: 楽しんでいただければ幸いです。
local: And I hope you enjoy it.
ja_pron: Tanoshinde itadakereba saiwai desu.
native: And I hope you enjoy it.

en: The first thing you learn in Japanese is this construction.
zh: 你學日文的第一件事是這個句型。
ja: 日本語で最初に学ぶのはこの文法構造です。
local: The first thing you learn in Japanese is this construction.
ja_pron: Nihongo de saisho ni manabu no wa kono bunpou kouzou desu.
native: The first thing you learn in Japanese is this construction.

en: Exueva, why this?
zh: Exueva，為什麼是這個？
ja: Exueva、なぜこれですか？
local: Exueva, why this?
ja_pron: Exueva, naze kore desu ka?
native: Exueva, why this?

en: So it's basically x is y, but the thing is, this y is not double of 2v, but this tessu here is 2v.
zh: 基本上是 x 是 y，但問題是這個 y 不是 2v 的兩倍，而這裡的 tessu 是 2v。
ja: 基本的に x は y ですが、問題はこの y が 2v の二倍ではなく、ここでの tessu は 2v です。
local: So it's basically x is y, but the thing is, this y is not double of 2v, but this tessu here is 2v.
ja_pron: Kihonteki ni x wa y desu ga, mondai wa kono y ga 2v no nibai de wa naku, koko de no tessu wa 2v desu.
native: So it's basically x is y, but the thing is, this y is not double of 2v, but this tessu here is 2v.

en: You probably heard this a lot in anime.
zh: 你可能在動畫中常聽到這個。
ja: アニメでよく聞くと思います。
local: You probably heard this a lot in anime.
ja_pron: Anime de yoku kiku to omoimasu.
native: You probably heard this a lot in anime.

en: You can say, is there this?
zh: 你可以說，有這個嗎？
ja: 「これがありますか？」と言えます。
local: You can say, is there this?
ja_pron: "Kore ga arimasu ka?" to iemasu.
native: You can say, is there this?

en: I'm Lisa, or maybe Desu no dor, which is that not the different, but Desu.
zh: 我是 Lisa，或者可能是 Desu no dor，那不是不同，而是 Desu。
ja: 私はリサです、または Desu no dor かもしれませんが、それは違いではなく、Desu です。
local: I'm Lisa, or maybe Desu no dor, which is that not the different, but Desu.
ja_pron: Watashi wa Risa desu, mata wa Desu no dor kamoshiremasen ga, sore wa chigai de wa naku, Desu desu.
native: I'm Lisa, or maybe Desu no dor, which is that not the different, but Desu.

en: So x, so why this?
zh: 所以 x，為什麼是這個？
ja: だから x、なぜこれですか？
local: So x, so why this?
ja_pron: Dakara x, naze kore desu ka?
native: So x, so why this?

en: So what is this?
zh: 那這是什麼？
ja: これは何ですか？
local: So what is this?
ja_pron: Kore wa nan desu ka?
native: So what is this?

en: What doing?
zh: 在做什麼？
ja: 何をしていますか？
local: What doing?
ja_pron: Nani o shite imasu ka?
native: What doing?

en: So this one is called particle, or topic marker.
zh: 這個叫做助詞，或主題標記。
ja: これは助詞、または話題のマーカーと呼ばれます。
local: So this one is called particle, or topic marker.
ja_pron: Kore wa joshi, mata wa wadai no ma-ka- to yobaremasu.
native: So this one is called particle, or topic marker.

en: This is basically indicating what the topic is in this sand vent.
zh: 這基本上是在指出這個句子中的主題是什麼。
ja: これは基本的にこの文の話題が何かを示しています。
local: This is basically indicating what the topic is in this sand vent.
ja_pron: Kore wa kihonteki ni kono bun no wadai ga nani ka o shimeshite imasu.
native: This is basically indicating what the topic is in this sand vent.

en: So this basically, what?
zh: 所以這基本上是什麼？
ja: つまり、これは基本的に何ですか？
local: So this basically, what?
ja_pron: Tsumari, kore wa kihonteki ni nan desu ka?
native: So this basically, what?

en: You can translate like arts for or speaking out.
zh: 你可以翻譯成「關於」或「說出」。
ja: 「〜について」や「話すこと」と訳せます。
local: You can translate like arts for or speaking out.
ja_pron: "~ni tsuite" ya "hanasu koto" to yakusemasu.
native: You can translate like arts for or speaking out.

en: So this actually, it really means speaking out of x, it is y.
zh: 所以這實際上真的表示說出 x 是 y。
ja: つまり、これは実際に「xについて話すと、それはyです」という意味です。
local: So this actually, it really means speaking out of x, it is y.
ja_pron: Tsumari, kore wa jissai ni "x ni tsuite hanasu to, sore wa y desu" to iu imi desu.
native: So this actually, it really means speaking out of x, it is y.

en: So we don't have the word for it.
zh: 所以我們沒有對應的單字。
ja: だからそれに対応する単語はありません。
local: So we don't have the word for it.
ja_pron: Dakara sore ni taiou suru tango wa arimasen.
native: So we don't have the word for it.

en: So yeah.
zh: 就是這樣。
ja: そういうことです。
local: So yeah.
ja_pron: Sou iu koto desu.
native: So yeah.

en: So everyone loves Pikachu.
zh: 所以大家都喜歡皮卡丘。
ja: だからみんなピカチュウが大好きです。
local: So everyone loves Pikachu.
ja_pron: Dakara minna Pikachu ga daisuki desu.
native: So everyone loves Pikachu.

en: Pikachu.
zh: 皮卡丘。
ja: ピカチュウ。
local: Pikachu.
ja_pron: Pikachu.
native: Pikachu.

en: I mean, I love Pikachu who doesn't.
zh: 我是說，我愛皮卡丘，誰不愛呢？
ja: つまり、私はピカチュウが大好きです。誰が嫌いでしょうか？
local: I mean, I love Pikachu who doesn't.
ja_pron: Tsumari, watashi wa Pikachu ga daisuki desu. Dare ga kirai deshou ka?
native: I mean, I love Pikachu who doesn't.

en: If I were to say Pikachu is cute, I would have to make a sand vent.
zh: 如果我要說皮卡丘很可愛，我必須造一個句子。
ja: もしピカチュウはかわいいと言うなら、文を作らなければなりません。
local: If I were to say Pikachu is cute, I would have to make a sand vent.
ja_pron: Moshi Pikachu wa kawaii to iu nara, bun o tsukuranakereba narimasen.
native: If I were to say Pikachu is cute, I would have to make a sand vent.

en: Speaking of Pikachu, it's cute.
zh: 說到皮卡丘，它很可愛。
ja: ピカチュウと言えば、かわいいです。
local: Speaking of Pikachu, it's cute.
ja_pron: Pikachu to ieba, kawaii desu.
native: Speaking of Pikachu, it's cute.

en: I think most people know the word for cute, which is kawaii.
zh: 我想大多數人都知道「可愛」這個詞，就是 kawaii。
ja: ほとんどの人は「かわいい」という言葉を知っていると思います。
local: I think most people know the word for cute, which is kawaii.
ja_pron: Hotondo no hito wa "kawaii" to iu kotoba o shitte iru to omoimasu.
native: I think most people know the word for cute, which is kawaii.

en: kawaii.
zh: kawaii。
ja: かわいい。
local: kawaii.
ja_pron: Kawaii.
native: kawaii.

en: But be careful because there is a word kawaii, called blacky, which sounds very similar, but
zh: 但要小心，因為有一個叫 blacky 的詞，發音很像 kawaii，但
ja: しかし注意してください。似た音の「blacky」という言葉がありますが、
local: But be careful because there is a word kawaii, called blacky, which sounds very similar, but
ja_pron: Shikashi chuui shite kudasai. Nita oto no "blacky" to iu kotoba ga arimasu ga,
native: But be careful because there is a word kawaii, called blacky, which sounds very similar, but

en: it means scary.
zh: 它的意思是可怕的。
ja: それは怖いという意味です。
local: it means scary.
ja_pron: Sore wa kowai to iu imi desu.
native: it means scary.

en: So you might end up saying, oh, you're scary.
zh: 所以你可能會說，喔，你很可怕。
ja: だから「おお、怖いね」と言ってしまうかもしれません。
local: So you might end up saying, oh, you're scary.
ja_pron: Dakara "Oo, kowai ne" to itte shimau kamoshiremasen.
native: So you might end up saying, oh, you're scary.

en: But you wanted to say, you're cute.
zh: 但你本來想說的是你很可愛。
ja: でも本当は「かわいい」と言いたかったのです。
local: But you wanted to say, you're cute.
ja_pron: Demo hontou wa "kawaii" to iitakatta no desu.
native: But you wanted to say, you're cute.

en: Yeah.
zh: 是的。
ja: そうです。
local: Yeah.
ja_pron: Sou desu.
native: Yeah.

en: So kawaii, cute, kawaii, scary.
zh: 所以 kawaii 是可愛，kawaii 是可怕。
ja: つまり、kawaii はかわいい、kawaii は怖いです。
local: So kawaii, cute, kawaii, scary.
ja_pron: Tsumari, kawaii wa kawaii, kawaii wa kowai desu.
native: So kawaii, cute, kawaii, scary.

en: So kawaii.
zh: 所以是 kawaii。
ja: だからかわいいです。
local: So kawaii.
ja_pron: Dakara kawaii desu.
native: So kawaii.

en: It's one, one, e, double, e.
zh: 它是 k-a-w-a-i-i。
ja: それは k-a-w-a-i-i です。
local: It's one, one, e, double, e.
ja_pron: Sore wa k-a-w-a-i-i desu.
native: It's one, one, e, double, e.

en: So kawaii, don't forget this last day, because everyone does.
zh: 所以 kawaii，不要忘記最後的 i，因為大家都會忘。
ja: だからかわいいの最後の「い」を忘れないでください。みんな忘れますから。
local: So kawaii, don't forget this last day, because everyone does.
ja_pron: Dakara kawaii no saigo no "i" o wasurenaide kudasai. Minna wasuremasu kara.
native: So kawaii, don't forget this last day, because everyone does.

en: So Pikachu, wah, kawaii, this means arts for Pikachu.
zh: 所以皮卡丘，は，かわいい，這表示「關於皮卡丘」。
ja: だからピカチュウはかわいい、これは「ピカチュウについて」という意味です。
local: So Pikachu, wah, kawaii, this means arts for Pikachu.
ja_pron: Dakara Pikachu wa kawaii, kore wa "Pikachu ni tsuite" to iu imi desu.
native: So Pikachu, wah, kawaii, this means arts for Pikachu.

en: It is cute.
zh: 它很可愛。
ja: かわいいです。
local: It is cute.
ja_pron: Kawaii desu.
native: It is cute.

en: So this part called wah.
zh: 這部分叫做 は。
ja: この部分は「は」と呼ばれます。
local: So this part called wah.
ja_pron: Kono bubun wa "wa" to yobaremasu.
native: So this part called wah.

en: You will find this in the phrase, four, hello, which is one, e, t, wah.
zh: 你會在問候語「こんにちは」中找到它，寫作 こ ん に ち は。
ja: これは「こんにちは」という挨拶の中にあります。「こんにちは」は「こ ん に ち は」と書きます。
local: You will find this in the phrase, four, hello, which is one, e, t, wah.
ja_pron: Kore wa "konnichiwa" to iu aisatsu no naka ni arimasu. "Konnichiwa" wa "ko n ni chi wa" to kakimasu.
native: You will find this in the phrase, four, hello, which is one, e, t, wah.

en: So here, you see, wah, x, wah, y, this is the same wah.
zh: 所以這裡，你看到 は，x，は，y，這是同一個 は。
ja: だからここで、「は x は y」は同じ「は」です。
local: So here, you see, wah, x, wah, y, this is the same wah.
ja_pron: Dakara koko de, "wa x wa y" wa onaji "wa" desu.
native: So here, you see, wah, x, wah, y, this is the same wah.

en: But here, you have learned here, I got it already.
zh: 但是這裡，你已經學過了，我已經懂了。
ja: しかしここでは、すでに学んでいます。理解しました。
local: But here, you have learned here, I got it already.
ja_pron: Shikashi koko de wa, sudeni manande imasu. Rikai shimashita.
native: But here, you have learned here, I got it already.

en: You already know that this is supposed to pronounce like, ha, ha, which can mean it as well, ha.
zh: 你已經知道這個應該發音為 は，は，也可以表示「葉」的意思。
ja: これは「は」と発音し、「葉」という意味もあります。
local: You already know that this is supposed to pronounce like, ha, ha, which can mean it as well, ha.
ja_pron: Kore wa "ha" to hatsuon shi, "ha" to iu imi mo arimasu.
native: You already know that this is supposed to pronounce like, ha, ha, which can mean it as well, ha.

en: But here, we obviously pronounce like, wah, kawaii, t, wah.
zh: 但這裡，我們明顯發音為 は，かわいい、は。
ja: しかしここでは明らかに「わ」と発音します。「かわいいは」です。
local: But here, we obviously pronounce like, wah, kawaii, t, wah.
ja_pron: Shikashi koko de wa akiraka ni "wa" to hatsuon shimasu. "Kawaii wa" desu.
native: But here, we obviously pronounce like, wah, kawaii, t, wah.

en: It's because if you use this, wah, as a topic marker, particle, then you have to pronounce like, wah, not ha.
zh: 因為如果你用 は 作為主題標記助詞，就必須發音為 わ，而不是 は。
ja: これは「は」を話題の助詞として使う場合、「わ」と発音しなければならないからです。
local: It's because if you use this, wah, as a topic marker, particle, then you have to pronounce like, wah, not ha.
ja_pron: Kore wa "wa" o wadai no joshi to shite tsukau baai, "wa" to hatsuon shinakereba naranai kara desu.
native: It's because if you use this, wah, as a topic marker, particle, then you have to pronounce like, wah, not ha.

en: You can ask ha only in the word.
zh: 你只能在詞中問 は。
ja: 「は」は単語の中でのみ「は」と発音できます。
local: You can ask ha only in the word.
ja_pron: "Ha" wa tango no naka de nomi "ha" to hatsuon dekimasu.
native: You can ask ha only in the word.

en: So for example, as a word, it, you'd say ha, or the word, spring.
zh: 例如，作為詞語，你會說 は，或是「春」這個詞。
ja: 例えば単語としては「は」と言いますし、「春」という言葉もそうです。
local: So for example, as a word, it, you'd say ha, or the word, spring.
ja_pron: Tatoeba tango to shite wa "ha" to iimasu shi, "haru" to iu kotoba mo sou desu.
native: So for example, as a word, it, you'd say ha, or the word, spring.

en: It's harder.
zh: 這比較難。
ja: これは難しいです。
local: It's harder.
ja_pron: Kore wa muzukashii desu.
native: It's harder.

en: You rock, use the same one, but you pronounce like, ha.
zh: 你看，使用同一個，但你發音為 は。
ja: 見てください。同じものを使いますが、「は」と発音します。
local: You rock, use the same one, but you pronounce like, ha.
ja_pron: Mite kudasai. Onaji mono o tsukaimasu ga, "ha" to hatsuon shimasu.
native: You rock, use the same one, but you pronounce like, ha.

en: Okay.
zh: 好的。
ja: はい。
local: Okay.
ja_pron: Hai.
native: Okay.

en: So why is it wah?
zh: 那為什麼是 は 呢？
ja: ではなぜ「は」なのでしょうか？
local: So why is it wah?
ja_pron: Dewa naze "wa" nanodeshou ka?
native: So why is it wah?

en: How is that topic marker?
zh: 它怎麼成為主題標記？
ja: それはどうやって話題のマーカーになるのですか？
local: How is that topic marker?
ja_pron: Sore wa dou yatte wadai no ma-ka- ni naru no desu ka?
native: How is that topic marker?

en: It means hello.
zh: 它的意思是你好。
ja: それは「こんにちは」という意味です。
local: It means hello.
ja_pron: Sore wa "konnichiwa" to iu imi desu.
native: It means hello.

en: So, kawaii, t is an old word for today, although we use the word jaw, jaw, for the word for today.
zh: 所以，konnichi 是今天的舊詞，雖然我們用 jaw 這個詞表示今天。
ja: つまり、「こんにちは」は昔の「今日」という言葉ですが、現代では「じょう」という言葉を使います。
local: So, kawaii, t is an old word for today, although we use the word jaw, jaw, for the word for today.
ja_pron: Tsumari, "konnichi" wa mukashi no "kyou" to iu kotoba desu ga, gendai de wa "jou" to iu kotoba o tsukaimasu.
native: So, kawaii, t is an old word for today, although we use the word jaw, jaw, for the word for today.

en: But on me, t, you still mean today.
zh: 但在某些情況下，t 仍然表示今天。
ja: しかし場合によっては、「と」はまだ「今日」を意味します。
local: But on me, t, you still mean today.
ja_pron: Shikashi baai ni yotte wa, "to" wa mada "kyou" o imi shimasu.
native: But on me, t, you still mean today.

en: And wah, topic marker, speaking of, so it means speaking of today.
zh: 而 は 作為主題標記，表示說到，所以意思是說到今天。
ja: そして「は」は話題の助詞で、「今日について話す」という意味です。
local: And wah, topic marker, speaking of, so it means speaking of today.
ja_pron: Soshite "wa" wa wadai no joshi de, "kyou ni tsuite hanasu" to iu imi desu.
native: And wah, topic marker, speaking of, so it means speaking of today.

en: So, when everyone met, we were like, oh, that's for today, speaking of today.
zh: 所以，當大家見面時，我們會說，喔，那是說到今天。
ja: だからみんなが会ったとき、「ああ、それは今日についてだね」と言います。
local: So, when everyone met, we were like, oh, that's for today, speaking of today.
ja_pron: Dakara minna ga atta toki, "Aa, sore wa kyou ni tsuite da ne" to iimasu.
native: So, when everyone met, we were like, oh, that's for today, speaking of today.

en: Such a nice, lovely day.
zh: 多麼美好可愛的一天。
ja: なんて素敵で可愛い日でしょう。
local: Such a nice, lovely day.
ja_pron: Nante suteki de kawaii hi deshou.
native: Such a nice, lovely day.

en: It was like that.
zh: 就是這樣。
ja: そんな感じでした。
local: It was like that.
ja_pron: Sonna kanji deshita.
native: It was like that.

en: So kawaii, t, wah.
zh: 所以是 こんにちは。
ja: だから「こんにちは」です。
local: So kawaii, t, wah.
ja_pron: Dakara "konnichiwa" desu.
native: So kawaii, t, wah.

en: That's why we use this wah.
zh: 這就是為什麼我們用 は。
ja: これが「は」を使う理由です。
local: That's why we use this wah.
ja_pron: Kore ga "wa" o tsukau riyuu desu.
native: That's why we use this wah.

en: Normally, we put this jaw, right?
zh: 通常我們會用 じょう，對吧？
ja: 普通は「じょう」を使いますよね？
local: Normally, we put this jaw, right?
ja_pron: Futsuu wa "jou" o tsukaimasu yo ne?
native: Normally, we put this jaw, right?

en: jaw is the word for today, in the modern Japanese.
zh: じょう是現代日語中表示今天的詞。
ja: 「じょう」は現代日本語で「今日」を意味する言葉です。
local: jaw is the word for today, in the modern Japanese.
ja_pron: "Jou" wa gendai nihongo de "kyou" o imi suru kotoba desu.
native: jaw is the word for today, in the modern Japanese.
